tasks.short: Recommend policies supporting water resource and conservation goals.

steps.what: Retrieve current water policies and map actual conservation evidence to their clauses
inputs: actual approved policies and water assessment records
outputs: checked policy clauses and conservation evidence

steps.what: Develop water policy recommendations and evaluate conservation, supply and community tradeoffs
inputs: checked policy clauses and conservation evidence
actual water goals and affected interests

steps.what: Write and approve complete final water policy recommendation and exact recipient
inputs: specialist policy recommendations and reasons
outputs: approved final recommendation with exact authority recipient

steps.what: Send approved final water policy recommendation to the designated authority
inputs: approved final recommendation with exact authority recipient

tasks.design: Configure native version and clause views in {DOCS} alongside actual water assessment references. The specialist checks evidence, develops recommendations and writes the complete final proposal before approving its separate send. Recommendation does not enact a regulation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual matching of current clauses and assessment references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned document and obligation views.
tasks.still_hard: Conservation goals, competing water interests and policy feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding who bears water allocation consequences.
tasks.altitude: Less reference reconciliation before specialist policy judgment.

evidence.claim: Versioned policy libraries and obligation mapping exist; their use for water policy evidence is proposed.

assumptions: Shares and remaining effort are provisional; verify residual reference reconciliation after existing tools. Existing routing and runtime earn no saving.

actual field conditions and crew capability

inputs: approved final capture instructions and exact crew recipients

inputs: actual supervision findings and crew outcomes

tasks.design: Configure a native work-order view in {OPS_SYSTEM} linking actual permit versions and reported site status.
